title: The selected symmetric two-radius chart has a unique third-order jet but one fourth-order freedom remains

pre_flight.question: Transport the first exact theta selector through the regular (p,a) chart and determine exactly what order of chart jet becomes unique.
pre_flight.rederived_inputs: Use K1727's isolated algebraic seed, K1731's exact chart, the K1743 first- and second-order chart jet, and the independently replayed K1747 invariant centers; K1748 is not assumed.
pre_flight.problem_matched_gate: Solve the two third-order chain-rule equations for r_3=-80/3 and x_3=theta_* through the same nonzero chart Jacobian.
pre_flight.anti_overclaim: The transport decides a third-order jet only; it cannot create an x_4 condition, a complete branch, finite-strength ordering or global optimality.

coefficient_convention.chart_path: p(s)=p_0+P s+P_2 s^2+P_3 s^3+O(s^4), a(s)=a_0+A s+A_2 s^2+A_3 s^3+O(s^4), with s=sqrt(q); coefficients do not include factorials.

third_order_chart_solution.definitions: Let v_i=(P_i,A_i), F=(r,x), J=DF(p_0,a_0), and D^kF denote exact chart derivatives at the K1727 point.
third_order_chart_solution.uniqueness: det J is nonzero at the isolated K1727 seed, so the exact algebraic right-hand side determines v_3 uniquely.
third_order_chart_solution.replay: Arbitrary-precision formal series in the exact moment chart reproduce r_3=-80/3 and x_3=theta_*; the displayed decimals are reports of the exact algebraic solution, not replacement definitions.

remaining_freedom.selected_fourth_invariant: K1747 also fixes r_4=delta_*, supplying one affine equation for the two fourth-order chart coefficients.
remaining_freedom.dimension: x_4 remains absent from the q^7 selector, so one fourth-order chart degree remains free.
remaining_freedom.honest_boundary: K1748 proves a unique third-order chart jet, not a complete local analytic branch.

post_flight.overclaim_check: Reject complete-branch, finite-strength, remote-boundary, all-seed and physical promotion.
post_flight.counterexample_seam: Distinct regular paths with the selected p,a coefficients through s^3 but different x_4 values agree with every condition proved here.
post_flight.mistyping_check: P_3 and A_3 multiply s^3 directly; treating them as third derivatives would introduce a factor of six.
post_flight.reproducibility_seam: The exact invariant centers are replayed in Q(u,sqrt(u)); an independent high-precision chart-series solve reproduces P_3 and A_3 and the hostile probe rejects promoted scope.

scope_guard: This exact finite-jet statement is local to the regular symmetric two-radius chart near the K1727 seed. It does not cover the u=q singular face, remote branches, moving or growing supports, unrestricted stationary field laws, a complete branch, a global optimizer or a source-owned physical GU state.
